title: Geonomics Native Schema Mapping, Initial-State Adapter & Seed Authority Closure
goal: terminally close the 19 explicit R4.34 native-schema authority gaps without executing Geonomics or interpreting ARCANA effective/proxy population as literal census individuals

authorities.geometry: canonical raster/grid index coordinate system only: dim from source, res=(1,1), ulc=(0,0), prj=None; no km/km2 claim
authorities.time: bijection between integer model-step index and exact canonical age axis, retaining exact physical edge durations and forbidding interpolation/extrapolation
authorities.seed: reuse exact per-job seed from authoritative R4_3_SEED_LEDGER.json; no new seeds
authorities.scaling: identity values only; no automatic rescale/clip
authorities.J14_J18_population: one nonliteral connectivity carrier per active deme; population/effective-population value retained as sidecar weight; demographic count adjudication forbidden
authorities.J14_J18_initial_state: exact deme-center coordinate injection authority targeting Geonomics Model.add_individuals; no random initialization
authorities.J14_J18_K_layer: binary support scaffold for construction only, K_factor=1, never an ARCANA carrying-capacity claim
authorities.J21_layers: environment and producer-support arrays become provenance-separated defined layer sets; no numeric fusion and no producer-agent synthesis
